decisions.reason: As a very recent 2023 launch close to the core upholstery range and prominent enough to merit its own page, it is a low-cost option worth keeping while the firm learns more about demand in a growing market.

This decorative fabric fits the established assortment, likely requires limited additional commitment to maintain, and there is not yet enough negative evidence after one year to justify abandoning the option.
Its flame-retardant functional feature broadens the firm's contract and hospitality relevance, so keeping it preserves upside in a promising niche while uncertainty is still resolving.

Because it builds directly on the firm's established design-led decoration offer, the cost of continuing it is likely modest relative to the value of retaining variety and observing market response for another period.

Although less prominently presented, it still aligns with the firm's core textile capabilities and broad-range strategy, so real-options logic favors keeping it on the market until clearer evidence emerges.
